source_role: Reference-assisted wire reimplementation and narrow QUIC stream adapter; no upstream whole-file or runtime import
hash_basis: sha256 is over the original Git blob at the fixed commit, before Windows CRLF conversion

reference_scope: HTTP/3 authentication request/response, status 233 and Hysteria headers
QUIC varint, TCP request 0x401 and UDP fragment field order
TUIC v5 command/address framing for streams and datagrams
TLS exporter authentication using UUID label and password context

adaptations: Use node-session live multi-user Host and UUID/password profiles instead of upstream single static credentials and routing
Constant-time credential/token comparison without logging supplied secrets
Ten-second total handshake/authentication deadline and bounded unauthenticated pending streams
Fresh per-connection exporter authentication before admitting resumed or early TUIC payload; disable Hysteria early data
Listener-owned cancellation/join tree, bounded connections/streams/UDP sessions/targets/reassembly and packet buffers
Decode framing and padding before Host payload accounting; outgoing destination/source validation and cancellation-safe session ownership
QuicStream forwards Quinn flush/shutdown directly and omits shoes AsyncPing/AsyncStream abstractions
src/udp.rs session/reassembly queues and src/obfs.rs Salamander packet wrapper are locally implemented, not imported shoes files
